stepDescriptions.implementation: We prototype, validate, and deploy AI agents or automations directly into your workflows, integrating APIs and data pipelines for immediate operational impact.
stepDescriptions.optimization: We monitor performance dashboards, fine-tune models, and expand automation scenarios to keep your AI stack optimized and scaling with your business.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This placeholder policy outlines how we expect to collect, use, and protect information shared with us. We'll replace it with the final legal copy before launch.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
body: We collect the details you share when you request a demo, subscribe to updates, or otherwise get in touch with us.
Technical information such as browser type, device identifiers, and aggregate usage analytics may also be captured to keep the experience smooth.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information
body: We use collected information to respond to enquiries, deliver requested resources, and improve the performance of our products and services.
Occasionally we may send service updates or relevant announcements; you can opt out of these communications at any time.

sections.heading: 3. Your Choices
body: You can ask us to update or delete your data, and you can object to certain types of processing where applicable.
Additional tooling for managing preferences will be provided when the final legal text is published.

privacy.contact: If you have questions about this policy, email privacy@expandmatrix.com and we’ll be happy to help.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These temporary terms describe how we expect our collaboration to work. They will be replaced with the final, legally reviewed document before the site goes live.

sections.heading: 1. Using Our Services
body: Our services help teams design, deploy, and manage AI-driven products. Access is provided for legitimate business activities and may not be misused.
We may update functionality from time to time; staying informed about updates is part of using the platform responsibly.

sections.heading: 2. Intellectual Property
body: Unless stated otherwise, ExpandMatrix retains ownership of platform assets, designs, and proprietary tooling.
Clients retain ownership of their own data and may grant us limited rights to process it for delivery of agreed services.

sections.heading: 3. Liability and Support
body: We work hard to deliver reliable solutions, but the service is provided as-is while in preview. We are not liable for indirect losses arising from experimental features.
Support requests can be sent to support@expandmatrix.com and we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

terms.contact: Questions about these terms? Email legal@expandmatrix.com so we can clarify anything you need.
